svg.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding adds waves of different frequencies to each embedding dimension
svg.desc: A line chart showing four sine and cosine curves at increasing frequencies plotted against sequence position, illustrating how the original Transformer positional encoding assigns each embedding dimension a wave of a different frequency so that each position gets a unique combined signal.
svg.text: Positional encoding: different frequencies per dimension
high frequency (early dims, changes fast between adjacent positions)
low frequency (later dims, changes slowly across many positions)
Every position gets a unique combined signal across all dimensions
